item.title: Burnt Out Possum Too Tired to Be Feral Today
item.description: A sleepy possum lies flat on its belly clutching a crumpled snack wrapper, simply too tired to be feral today. Perfect for burnt out coworkers and possum lovers, it makes a funny gift. Available on stickers, hoodies and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Tired Possum Hugging a Candle Spiritual Burnout
item.description: A droopy-eyed possum lies flat on its belly hugging a tiny lit candle, because some days you're tired in a spiritual way. Perfect for burnt-out coworkers and possum lovers, it makes a funny gift on stickers, sweatshirts and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Spooky Raccoon Trash Witch Open for Business
item.description: A raccoon in a witch hat holds a tiny lantern, proudly announcing it's a trash witch open for business. A funny gift for raccoon lovers and witchy friends alike. Find it on stickers, hoodies and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Spooky Possum in Witch Hat Awkward Wave
item.description: A tiny possum in a witch hat gives a shy little wave: "Boo. Anyway, I'm leaving now." Perfect for introverts who show up, say hi, and quietly slip out of the party. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Unhinged Raccoon Holding a Candle at Night
item.description: A wide-eyed raccoon clutching a lit candle, proudly nocturnal and slightly unhinged. A perfect gift for night owls, trash panda fans and anyone who does their best work after midnight. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.
